messages.author: memegoddess
messages.content:
On launch, game checks for `-mod`, and then takes a list of package IDs separated by either `;` or `,`. It adds those mods to the active mod list, and then does an auto sort. Means that you can enable mods and it'll override "Game has changed from 1.X to 1.Y, all mods have been removed", or first time launch in a new savedatafolder (new mod, running on a pipeline, etc).

So, you can do `-mod brrainz.harmony,MemeGoddess.GiddyUp` and it'll add Giddy Up and Harmony, with Harmony correctly being before core <:VoHiYo:802914521919520808> 
The code also allows a ton of different formats, so `-mod=brrainz.harmony;memegoddess.giddyup` would work the exact same. Same with `-MOD "brrainz.harmony; memeGoddess.giddyup"`
